scope.basis: Previously saved ordinary JSON scalar records and original producer output path lists only; no new mechanical or geometry evaluation.
scope.qualification: Production cached gates and saved geometric observations retain their original scope. This document grants no new HP/contact/pressure/grip/release/stability qualification.
scope.supersedes_temporary_baseline: PHYSICAL_INTERPRETATION_BASELINE.json/md were interim historical notes while C5 ran; the final files include the closed C5 outcome.

historical_coverage.meaning: 17 chronological target identities were reached through ten separately saved continuation windows. Nine fresh saved anchors repeat earlier target identities; the actual 26 saved records are retained. This is not one-window full-prefix reexecution.

C5.range_rejection_interpretation: At target 0, checks 7/8/9/10 each rejected factor 1 solely for unsupported_arithmetic_range; parent independently confirmed the immediately following factor 0.5 was accepted with J=1. These are handled internal backtracking events; failed_attempts=0 and bisection_depth=0. No failing primitive was saved for these events, so no operator-level cause or physical instability is inferred.
C5.zero_endpoint_interpretation: Input displacement returned to 0 with the original cached convergence gates passing. Raw nonzero R, q_out, weak body forces and Hu are retained. The endpoint is near the saved undeformed observables; exact full-field restoration, reversibility, stability and free workpiece release are not established.

zero_endpoint_residual.meaning: This is the cached equilibrium residual normalized by the saved near-zero load scale, not an HP error.

C5.flags_interpretation: This child executed [1.25,1.15,1,.75,.5,.25,0]; path_completed and unload_endpoint_reached are true, loading_peak_reached is false, task_target_executed/full_original_path_completed/full_extended_path_completed are false. The historical loading peak remains 1.4. No current task_transition is added; the first cross-kind proof remains deeper in parent_continuation.

same_displacement_comparisons.method: Scalar subtraction of already saved ordinary values only, preserving both state identities and raw roundoff-scale differences.
same_displacement_comparisons.limits: Small scalar differences do not establish full-field equality, a reversible constitutive path, zero hysteresis or dissipation, uniqueness or stability.

physical_findings.purpose: Demonstrate usable public saved-state continuation from circle loading to first unloading and all remaining unloading targets, while examining actual mechanical response and geometric proximity.
physical_findings.force_meaning: The listed on-workpiece lower-body Fx/Fy are nodal weak-force sums, split into material and Hu regularization components. They are not a resolved surface pressure or an effective gripping-force qualification; fixed workpiece holding and the symmetry setting remain.
physical_findings.geometry_meaning: Nearest unsigned boundary distance and far-right-tip-to-raster-boundary distance answer different questions. At peak 1.4 the nearest value is 0.06329727765158799 mm while the far-right tip remains 2.959839839455605 mm away. Saved non-intersection/near-touch/strict-overlap flags are retained; complete containment was not tested.
physical_findings.Hu_meaning: Hu is the saved displacement reference-Hessian indicator with units 1/mm; a maximum component is not itself the source or magnitude of the global weak body force.
physical_findings.recovery: During unloading, saved force/compression/Hu indicators recover toward their initial observables. The raw 0 endpoint is not clipped to zero and does not establish physical free release.
physical_findings.reference_scope: CREF1 independently checked only the ancestor loading state 1.15 mm. Its qualification does not transfer to the peak, new unloading states or the whole historical path.

media_index.basis: Exact output paths declared by original producer ordinary receipts; no media/CSV payload was read, hashed or decoded for this interpretation.

current_C5.pixel_QA: Parent inspected the four new PNGs once; this author did not inspect pixels. Parent reported readable plots and a small retained third-panel convergence legend/title overlap.

media_index.plot_interpretation: Comparison images show this child’s actual maximum stroke anchor 1.25 and final 0 at true scale plus the declared display supplement; they do not show a newly repeated 1.4 peak. Force/distance curves preserve all seven accepted states and raw zero-endpoint values. Field images display saved quantities; convergence images project saved scalar history.

next_minimum_useful_stage.proposal_zh: 下一步只准备一个面向最右尖端的圆形右移布置输入与未变形兼容性对照，不直接重跑大行程。先从实际网格/域/连通与工件覆盖核定可行位置，保留当前圆形为对照，检查完整有限边界、机构实体/端口/支撑及固定体覆盖、域边界和右侧介质是否存在，再选定新坐标/半径及其明确边界条件。当前尚不能承诺 center=(75,40)、r=9 可用：若实际右域界为84，该圆会贴外边界并失去右侧介质，必须在未来准备卡中实际核清。兼容性准备完成后，才根据尖端与完整圆形边界关系选择一个有物理目的的小加载段，另行授权；本次不实现或运行新task。
next_minimum_useful_stage.no_routine_HP: Handled internal range rejections and an input return do not by themselves call for a new routine HP run or automatic numerical-guard changes.
